about.label: Who I Am
about.title: About me
about.intro: Hi, I'm Chris! I am a frontend developer who loves turning ideas into clean, responsive interfaces that are a pleasure to use. What fascinates me about coding is the moment when a complex problem suddenly becomes a simple, elegant solution – and the fact that web development never stands still.
highlights: I am based in Detmold, Germany, and open to working remotely.
I am curious about new technologies and keep expanding my skills – right now with a strong focus on Angular and TypeScript.

I approach problems analytically: understand them, break them down, test and improve. Every challenge teaches me something new, and I enjoy finding solutions together with a team through creativity, persistence and collaboration.

skills.label: Technologies
skills.title: Skill Set
skills.text: I build modern web applications with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular. I enjoy learning new technologies and adapting to new tools quickly, because keeping up with the rapid changes in web development is part of my daily work.
skills.note: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.
skills.growthHint: I have a special interest in learning

projects.label: Portfolio
projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.text: Explore a selection of my work here – interact with the projects to see my skills in action.

items.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop, assign contacts, priorities and categories – all data is stored in Firebase.
items.elPolloLoco: Jump-and-run game based on object-oriented JavaScript. Guide the character through the level, avoid obstacles and defeat the giant crazy chicken.
items.memory: Memory card game for two players, written in TypeScript without any framework. Choose between four themes and three board sizes, with a live scoreboard and 3D card flip animations.

sections.title: 1. Controller
2. Overview
paragraphs: This website does not use cookies, tracking or analytics tools. Personal data is only processed to the extent necessary to provide the website and to answer your messages.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and server log files
paragraphs: This website is hosted on the server of Developer Akademie GmbH, Tassiloplatz 25, 81541 München, Germany. When you visit the website, the server automatically stores information in log files: IP address, date and time of the request, requested page, browser type and version, operating system and referrer URL.

This data is required to deliver the website securely and is processed on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure and stable operation of the website). It is not merged with other data sources.

sections.title: 4. Contact form
paragraphs: If you send me a message via the contact form, your name, email address and message are transmitted to my mail server and sent to me by email. I use this data exclusively to process your request.

The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR if your request is related to a contract or pre-contractual measures, otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in answering inquiries). Your data will be deleted as soon as your request has been completed, unless statutory retention obligations apply.

sections.title: 5. Language setting (local storage)
paragraphs: When you switch the language, your choice ("en" or "de") is stored in the local storage of your browser so that the website remembers it on your next visit. This information never leaves your device. You can delete it at any time via your browser settings.

sections.title: 6. Fonts
paragraphs: The fonts used on this website are hosted locally on this server. No connection to external font providers (e.g. Google Fonts) is established.

sections.title: 7. External links
paragraphs: This website contains links to external services such as GitHub. Data is only transmitted to these providers when you click on a link. Their own privacy policies apply.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), data portability (Art. 20 GDPR) and to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR). To exercise these rights, simply send me an email.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).

sections.title: 9. SSL/TLS encryption
paragraphs: For security reasons, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognize an encrypted connection by "https://" in the address bar of your browser.
